source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Hole numbers are a guess. The course winds between condo buildings on both sides of the main road, and the card puts all four par 4s first (holes 1-4), which fits no sensible walking order; holes were numbered by par and then by a walking loop from the clubhouse. The card has no yardages, so tees were placed from the photo.
unsure.2: Tee not clear; placed on the narrow strip between two ponds south-east of the green. Traced length (184 yd) is short for a par 4, so the real tee may be further back.
unsure.3: Tee not clear; placed at the south end of the fairway west of the small pond. Traced 228 yd, short for a par 4.
unsure.4: Tee not clear; placed at the north end of the fairway beside the large pond.
unsure.5: Tee not clear; placed in the open ground east of the green.
unsure.6: Tee not clear; placed by the cart path east of the green.
unsure.7: Tee not clear; placed south of the green beside the road. Could instead be played from the west.
unsure.8: Neither green nor tee is clear in the open strip south of hole 3; both placed by guess, and the direction of play may be the other way.
unsure.9: Not traced: could not find a ninth green in the photo.
